app.commerce.title: Commerce
app.commerce.shop.title: Shop
app.commerce.shop.lede: Shopify connection used by the webhook and inventory workflow.
app.commerce.shop.webhookSecret.label: Webhook shared secret
app.commerce.shop.webhookSecret.hint: Verifies incoming Shopify webhooks (HMAC). Required independently of the Admin API.
app.commerce.shop.adminApi.hint: When enabled, product webhooks are enriched with metafields fetched from the Shopify Admin API. When disabled, no Admin API calls are made.
app.commerce.shop.shopDomain.label: Shop domain
app.commerce.shop.apiVersion.label: API version
app.commerce.shop.clientId.label: Client ID
app.commerce.shop.clientSecret.label: Client secret
app.commerce.notifications.title: Notifications
app.commerce.notifications.lede: Destinations notified when an inventory, order or refund task is raised. Each enabled channel receives the same message in its own format. Stored separately from the Shopify credentials.
app.commerce.notifications.teams.hint: Teams Workflows / connector URL. Posts an Adaptive Card.
app.commerce.notifications.line.hint: Messaging API push (LINE Notify reached end of service in 2025).
app.commerce.notifications.webhook.hint: Posts structured JSON; the plain-text body is placed under the “Text field” key (default {code}).
app.commerce.notifications.email.subject: Subject prefix
app.commerce.notifications.email.hint: Comma-separate multiple recipients. Sent as plain-text UTF-8.
app.commerce.health.title: Health
app.commerce.health.lede: Alert thresholds for the integration health monitor. Metrics are always recorded; alerts are sent through the enabled channels in Notifications.
app.commerce.health.alerting.hint: When off, metrics are still recorded but no alerts are sent.
app.commerce.health.cooldown.label: Cooldown (minutes)
app.commerce.health.cooldown.hint: Minimum minutes between repeat alerts of the same kind.
app.commerce.health.hmac.enableLabel: Alert on failed webhook signature verifications
app.commerce.health.hmac.threshold.label: Threshold (count today)
app.commerce.health.apiErrorRate.enableL: Alert when the Shopify Admin API error rate is high
app.commerce.health.apiErrorRate.hint: 0.2 = alert at 20% errors once at least the minimum calls are seen.
Alert when the webhook processing error rate is high
app.commerce.health.processingLatency.hi: Receipt → completion. Exceeding this raises an alert.
app.commerce.tasks.title: Tasks
app.commerce.tasks.lede: Service-level rules for the workflow’s human tasks. A periodic scan escalates breaches: an alert through the Notifications channels plus the optional action below.
app.commerce.tasks.escalation.hint: When off, the scan does nothing.
app.commerce.tasks.cooldown.label: Cooldown (minutes)
app.commerce.tasks.cooldown.hint: Minimum minutes between repeat escalations of the same task.
app.commerce.tasks.unclaimed.enableLabel: Alert when a task stays unassigned too long
app.commerce.tasks.unclaimed.after.label: After (minutes)
app.commerce.tasks.openTooLong.enableLab: Alert when a task stays open too long (claimed or not)
app.commerce.tasks.overdue.enableLabel: Alert when a task is past its due date
app.commerce.tasks.overdue.grace.label: Grace (minutes)
app.commerce.tasks.overdue.hint: Only applies to tasks that have a due date set.
app.commerce.tasks.escalationAction.bump: Raise the priority of a breached task
app.commerce.tasks.escalationAction.hint: Applied to a breached task in addition to the alert. Leave the group blank to not reassign.
app.commerce.forecast.title: Forecast
app.commerce.forecast.lede: Sales velocity & stockout prediction. A periodic batch computes per-variant velocity from order history (feeding the inventory rules) and alerts on imminent stockouts through the Notifications channels.
app.commerce.forecast.velocity.hint: When off, the batch does nothing and cached velocity is left as-is.
Minimum minutes between repeat stockout alerts for the same variant.
app.commerce.forecast.stockout.enableLab: Alert on variants predicted to run out soon
Alert when current stock / velocity is at or below this many days.
app.commerce.replenishment.title: Replenishment
app.commerce.replenishment.lede: Auto-reorder proposals. A batch proposes purchase orders for variants that won’t cover the lead time + target cover at the current velocity; an operator approves, then the PO is sent to the supplier.
app.commerce.replenishment.hint: When off, no purchase-order proposals are created.
app.commerce.replenishment.roundTo.label: Round to (pack size)
app.commerce.replenishment.qtyFormula.hi: Order qty = round up of (velocity × (lead + cover) − stock), at least the min.
app.commerce.replenishment.supplier.hint: Email uses the SMTP transport from the Notifications > Email settings; only the recipient is set here.
app.commerce.locations.title: Locations
app.commerce.locations.lede: Cross-location allocation strategy. Per-location stock is ingested from Shopify; this advises which locations to draw from to fulfil a quantity (it does not override Shopify’s own fulfillment routing).
app.commerce.locations.strategy.label: Strategy
app.commerce.locations.priorityOrder.hin: Used by the “Priority order” strategy: draw from these locations first, in order, then the rest by most stock.
app.commerce.locations.safetyStock.label: Safety stock (per location)
app.commerce.locations.safetyStock.hint: Quantity held back at each location (not allocatable).
app.commerce.storefront.title: Storefront
app.commerce.storefront.lede: Headless storefront & real-time inventory. The publisher builds a sanitized public catalog the ichigo.js storefront reads; rebuild it from the Commerce Publishing app.
app.commerce.storefront.enable.hint: When off, the catalog/landing projection is not rebuilt.
app.commerce.storefront.storeName.label: Store name
app.commerce.storefront.currency.label: Fallback currency
app.commerce.storefront.currency.hint: Used only when a product carries no currency.
app.commerce.storefront.lowStock.label: Low-stock threshold
app.commerce.storefront.lowStock.hint: At/below this available quantity the storefront shows “only a few left”; 0 shows “sold out”.
app.commerce.crm.title: Customers (CRM)
app.commerce.crm.lede: Segmentation, behaviour alerts and abandoned-cart follow-up.
app.commerce.crm.alerts.enableLabel: Alert operators on newly VIP / at-risk / dormant customers
app.commerce.crm.abandonedCart.hint: Off by default. When off, operators still get the abandoned-cart summary.
app.commerce.reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
app.commerce.reconciliation.lede: A periodic batch compares the CMS mirror with Shopify and reports drift. Requires the Admin API. Healing is OFF by default — detect & report first.
app.commerce.reconciliation.perRun.label: Products per run
app.commerce.reconciliation.perRun.hint: A round-robin cursor covers the whole catalog over time.
app.commerce.reconciliation.sourceOfTrut: Decides the heal direction when auto-heal is enabled.
app.commerce.reconciliation.autoHeal.hin: Inventory is always reported, never auto-healed.
app.commerce.reconciliation.alert.label: Notify (debounced) when drift is detected
app.commerce.ingestion.title: Ingestion
app.commerce.ingestion.lede: Event intake is always on; this governs automatic replay of failed events and pruning of the event log.
Processed event-log entries older than this are pruned.
app.commerce.backorders.title: Backorders
app.commerce.backorders.lede: Shortfall & pre-order tracking. Shortfall backorders are raised only for stock-tracked items; pre-orders are detected by tag.
app.commerce.backorders.preorderTags.hin: Comma-separated Shopify tags (case-insensitive). Tagged products are backordered even when in stock. Leave blank to disable pre-order detection.
app.commerce.backorders.notify.onReady.l: When a backorder has stock (release task)
app.commerce.orderReview.title: Order review
app.commerce.orderReview.lede: Screening rules for paid orders. If any enabled rule matches, the order goes to a manual review task; otherwise it is auto-approved. Fail-open.
app.commerce.orderReview.enable.hint: When off, every order is auto-approved.
app.commerce.orderReview.highValue.enabl: Flag orders at/above a per-currency threshold
app.commerce.refundReview.title: Refund review
app.commerce.refundReview.lede: Screening rules for refunds (audit / fraud-monitoring only — nothing is written back to Shopify). Matching refunds go to a manual review task; otherwise auto-acknowledged. Fail-open.
app.commerce.refundReview.enable.hint: When off, every refund is auto-acknowledged.
app.commerce.refundReview.highValue.enab: Flag refunds at/above a per-currency threshold
app.commerce.refundReview.fullRefund.ena: Flag refunds returning the full order value
app.commerce.refundReview.noRestock.enab: Flag refunds that restock no inventory
app.commerce.inventoryRules.title: Inventory rules
app.commerce.inventoryRules.lede: Dynamic alert thresholds. Effective threshold per variant: manual override > first matching rule (top-down) > default > none.
app.commerce.inventoryRules.default.hint: Applied when no rule matches. Leave blank to monitor only products with a manual threshold.
app.commerce.inventoryRules.rules.groupT: Rules (evaluated top-down — put the most specific first)
app.commerce.inventoryRules.rules.empty: No rules. Add one to raise the threshold for matching products.
app.commerce.inventoryRules.rule.criteri: A rule matches when ALL declared criteria hold; comma-separated lists match any. Leave all blank for a catch-all.
app.commerce.statusBar.adminApiInvalid: Admin API needs shop domain, API version, client ID & secret
app.commerce.statusBar.notifInvalid: An enabled channel is missing required fields
app.commerce.dialog.unsavedBody2: Do you want to save your changes before closing?
app.commerce.status.adminApiInvalid: Enter the shop domain, API version, client ID and client secret, or turn off the Admin API.
app.commerce.status.notifInvalid: Complete the required fields for each enabled channel, or turn it off.
